ex.s: The most obvious advantage of online learning is that you can study anywhere and anytime.

ex.s: Before choosing to study online, consider whether you’re a self-motivated learner and if the material seems interesting enough to keep you going.

ex.s: The tip that comes up most often is simple: build online courses into your weekly schedule, just like what you would do with in-person courses.
